title: Catalytic application of a bimetallic–organic framework with phosphorus acid groups in the preparation of pyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidines via cooperative vinylogous anomeric-based oxidation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10150-10163
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08430F, Paper

The catalytic application of UiO-66(Fe/Zr)–N(CH2PO3H2)2 as a heterogenous catalyst was investigated for the synthesis of pyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidines.
